entities.name: Logical Empiricism
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A refinement of logical positivism developed by Hans Reichenbach, Carl Hempel, and Rudolf Carnap after emigrating from Europe to the United States. Relaxed the strict verification principle while maintaining commitment to empirical science and formal logic.
